elaine_cs: FYI support ticket #8721 — customer reports a sudden spike in 5xx for hosted API (/v1/generate) starting ~2026-03-15T11:00Z. sample req_id=req_9843, dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/stack/req_9843

deploy-bot: [alert] prod:canary cluster 5xx rate +145% over baseline (5m) — firing pager.

sam_sre: ack. Any recent canary/deploys pushed in the last 30m? tagging @kevin_oncall for oncall.

jamal_eng: that would be my deploy — pushed canary deploy-8791 ~2026-03-15T10:59:24. Small change: flipped tls strictness for upstreams (ENABLE_STRICT_TLS=true) behind a canary-only env.

sam_sre: ok let's try a quick repro against canary ingress. kevin, can you run the reproducer below and paste the response?

sam_sre: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d "{"input":"hi"}" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?route=canary```

kevin_oncall: ran it, getting 502 and TLS error. response body: "upstream error: tls: handshake failure: unexpected EOF"

kevin_oncall: pulled logs from runtime on node canary-03: 
```
2026-03-15T11:02:12Z runtime[pid=2345]: accept error: tls handshake failed: remote error: handshake failure
2026-03-15T11:02:12Z runtime[pid=2345]: request id=req_9843 route=/v1/generate -> upstream connect error: tls: unexpected EOF
```
jamal_eng: ugh — I forgot that the canary nodes are still on the older sidecar cert rotation flow. enabling strict TLS on the app side without the rotated certs will cause the handshake to fail. This is why only canary is impacted. My bad. :facepalm:

sam_sre: understood. proposed mitigation: flip the canary feature flag back to false (feature-gate service) and scale the canary down, then roll back the deploy properly. Jamal, can you flip the flag? I'll coordinate traffic.

jamal_eng: flipping now. command: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $MGMT_TOKEN" https://feature-gate.internal/api/v1/toggles/ENABLE_STRICT_TLS -d '{"value":false}'```

deploy-bot: feature-toggle ENABLE_STRICT_TLS -> false (by jamal_eng) at 2026-03-15T11:06:05Z. canary scale set to 0/2 by autopilot.

ops-bot: deploy rollback started: rollback deploy-8791 -> deploy-8787 (stable) using orchestration job #rollback-550.

kevin_oncall: post-toggle check: curl repro now returns 200 and payload. error rate back near baseline on dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/5xx (graphs show drop at 11:07Z). :white_check_mark:

sam_sre: great. closing the immediate incident. next steps: Jamal, open PR to add deploy-time gating that prevents enabling ENABLE_STRICT_TLS unless cert rotation completes on target canary nodes. Also add a pre-deploy check in pipeline that validates sidecar cert version parity.

jamal_eng: will do — creating PR + runbook update. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/deployments/pull/1245. Adding postmortem action items.

elaine_cs: I'll update the customer that we mitigated the issue and are following up with a permanent fix. thanks everyone for the quick response. :thumbsup:
